The program compared after the paint, not in the view; every compilation timed.
Probe samples' first-order values sent from the worker as data (step 7's first slice; it made the answer larger, and is off since 22cd278106).
A step's edit made after the paint, once the compiled run has drawn it (b37d2e6df1); each editor's decorations and probes' views reused across a drag's frames.
13 · the outline on its own8bf44f23cf, run 42670654733

The sidebar's outline built on its own after the paint, not in the page's view (bfbd88a1ae, 8bf44f23cf; Matthew: "no memoization, but isolation, instead"). Also samples as data off again (22cd278106), as on the team's hosted build. Its other run (42668742255) landed on a machine 20 to 40% slower on work this change does not touch, and read slower throughout.
14 · the page after a stepb310a58b67, run 42690151014

A probe's row abbreviates its value without rewriting all of it first (e1bb06d115, 99542e86e3); after a compiled answer, the worker's reuse plan and streams wait for its result and come with it as one action (a65a9e5f52); each projector drawn and each update named on the check's timeline (d1ef274c10, af099c780d, b310a58b67). Its machine was slower than build 13's (the worker's encode 70 to 82 ms, against 52): the fair comparison is build 13 with the same timing marks on a machine like it (af099c780d, run 42685958876, encode 68 to 86), see the text.
15 · livelits kept across an edit1da80a8022, run 42697957029

A livelit's cached view keyed on its own statics record, not the whole statics map and elaborated term (d35f2f2619, a1b43cba46): after an edit only the edited livelit is drawn again, not all 53; a probe's value check remembered per value (515813903a). Plotted: a run of a1b43cba46 with the autosave's parts timed (1da80a8022, nothing else changed), on a machine like build 13's (the worker's encode 56 to 72 ms, against 52). Its other run (a1b43cba46, run 42696123420) was on a machine like build 14's.
16 · the autosave on its ownf4bcd64cf7, run 42699757678

The autosave writes the page's model without going through the update (Main.apply), so the very same model comes back and nothing is drawn again: after each autosave, no calculate, whole view or outline (about 60 ms on build 15's run). On a machine like build 14's (the worker's encode 73 to 109 ms), so its steps and drag read slower than build 15's run.
17 · the comparison, only what changedb195b09088, run 42703776919

The comparison after a step erases only what the step changed: erase remembered per node (c016370918, b195b09088), since the new program is the old one's very objects but for 36 to 49 nodes (b34491d761). The comparison 33 to 43 ms before (run 42701761078), 1 ms now; the run kept at every step as before (5 of 5). On a machine like build 14's (the worker's encode 82 to 102 ms).
18 · the first step like the othersf125a69a7b, run 42713728065

A run of the slide's program right after each compilation, kept only as the printed answers (HazelJitRun.prime), the baseline the first step compares with: before it, every livelit counted as changed on the first step and all 53 were drawn again. The first step's first view 26 ms, from 65; its picture 92 ms, from 132 (build 17); 3 projectors drawn, not 54. A machine like build 14's (the worker's encode 71 to 88 ms).

rows: Handle a slider's change event without an edit of the program, as cut A did for its input events, or do the edit's work after the paint.
Statics and syntax (32 ms) and the whole slide's view (91 ms), all before the paint at 176 ms (build 8).

done (b37d2e6df1, build 12): when the compiled run has answered, the page draws first and makes the edit after the paint. A step shows in 19 to 24 ms (the first of four, 124). The edit itself is still made, after the paint (^ticket(721)).
Draw only the livelits a drag changes: make the editors' and projectors' views incremental.
Most of the page's view: 10.1 ms of a 17.1 ms median frame of a drag (build 8); and the whole views after each worker message.

first part done (d9d63c13af, build 12): each editor's decorations and probes' views reused across a drag's frames, the view 6.1 ms a frame (8.2 to 10.1 on builds 8 to 11). Then the outline out of the view (bfbd88a1ae, 8bf44f23cf; build 13), built on its own after the paint: the whole views after each worker message 45 to 63 ms (88 to 130 on build 12), a drag's view 4.9 ms a frame. Left: the projector layer, and those whole views. On build 14 the probe on the picture draws its row in 8 to 21 ms after each answer, not 44 to 91 (e1bb06d115). Left: every livelit drawn again when the dynamics are new (4 to 22 ms a view), and a probe's value check, which walks the whole value (4 to 14 ms). Build 15 (a1b43cba46): a livelit keyed on its own statics record, so after an edit only the edited one is drawn again (2 to 3 ms, not 9 to 14); a probe's value check remembered per value (515813903a). Left: every livelit drawn again when the worker's answer brings new dynamics (6 to 15 ms).
Compile the program once, not again after a step that changed only a livelit's model: keep the compiled program, and give it the new models.
126 to 141 ms of the page's thread after each step (build 8).

done (7f5add1519, 3e51af567f; builds 9 and 10): kept at every step on the Witch, 5 of 5; 29 to 51 ms of comparing after the paint in place of 126 to 141 ms of compiling. Next: a cheaper comparison, since 22 to 39 ms of it copies the program. The cheaper comparison: done (c016370918, b195b09088; build 17): 1 ms, from 33 to 43, by erasing only what a step changed.
Leave the worker out when the compiled run has answered: keep the run's answers when the worker catches up, and hold the worker's request until the steps stop.
The page drawing every livelit again from the worker's answer, to the same picture; the worker's run for each step of a quick series.

partly done (7f5add1519, build 9): the answers are kept each time the worker catches up (10 on the Witch) and its request is held 400 ms. But each of the worker's two messages still costs the page a calculate and a whole view, 95 to 143 ms a view (45 to 63 since build 13 took the outline out), now drawing every livelit from the kept answers. What is left is step 1's. More done (a65a9e5f52, build 14): after a compiled answer, the worker's reuse plan and streams wait for its result, so its first messages no longer cost a calculate and a whole view.
Send values as data where they cross: the worker's answer and its probe samples without ids, holes or closures.
The answer is 0.59 MB, encoded in 67 to 99 ms in the worker and decoded in 18 to 56 ms in the page (builds 9 and 10); the Witch's picture is 3 times smaller as data (^report(47)).

first slice tried, and off (1524e96da3, build 11; off since 22cd278106): the values that went as data came back the same, but only 5 a message passed the strict check, and rebuilding the samples lost Marshal's sharing, so the answer grew to 0.89 MB. Now a survey counts why values are not data; next, make data where samples are made (^ticket(718)).
The autosave: write the slide's text without printing the whole program again after each step, and its first save after a load without writing everything.
37 to 46 ms a second after each step, 27 to 36 of them printing the 2,222 lines again; 287 ms the first time after the slide loads (build 15).

started (f4bcd64cf7, build 16): the autosave no longer goes through the update, so the calculate, whole view and outline that followed each one (about 60 ms) are gone. Left: its own 37 to 46 ms, most of it the text, and the first save after a load.
